links.outcome: Whether clinicians caught and removed harmful LLM recommendations before finalizing documentation
links.effect: Actively harmful LLM recommendations in 7.8% of encounters, with 67 appearing in final documentation; clinicians did not modify documentation in 62% of encounters; risk mitigated in 118 encounters (8.0%).
links.quote: Safety assessments identified actively harmful recommendations from the LLM in 7.8% of encounters, with 67 such recommendations appearing in the final documentation.

links.outcome: Frequency of hallucinations in deployed LLM output
links.effect: Hallucinations were uncommon (50/1,469; 3.4%), most often mis-expanded acronyms or drug names.
links.quote: Hallucinations were uncommon (50/1,469; 3.4%), most often involving mis-expanded acronyms or drug names.

screen.reason: Evaluates real clinical deployment of an LLM-based clinical decision support tool embedded in EMR across 16 clinics in Kenya, assessing safety, hallucinations, and clinician adoption patterns without directly testing an intervention/guardrail variation.
